item.alone_adventure.crystalline_heart.t: A heart condensed from crystal, the crystals on it still shifting in color.
Regenerates 1 shield every 10 seconds after taking damage
Higher armor and armor toughness increase shield capacity and regen speed
item.alone_adventure.bleedingshield.tool: A shield forged from congealed blood, the blood still seeks to erode its wielder.
Every 2 armor points or 1 health point sacrificed converts to 1 armor toughness
item.alone_adventure.adaptive_flesh.tool: A squirming piece of living tissue that seems to learn alongside your pain.
Each hit of a damage type grants 1 layer of adaptation (15% per layer, max 5); taking a different damage type decays all existing layers by 1
item.alone_adventure.night_contract.tool: A pact signed in blood; moonlight is its gift, sunlight its curse.
In sunlight (daytime, unobstructed sky): health cannot regenerate, and you are afflicted with Wither
At night (indoors or outdoors): restores 1 health every 4 seconds and grants Night Vision
Can sleep during the day; sleeping in daylight skips straight to nightfall
Brighter moon phases grant higher bonuses: new moon +10%, up to full moon +50% movement speed and crit damage
Current moon: %1$s -- +%2$s movement speed and crit damage
item.alone_adventure.survival_whimper.to: A whimper that refuses to die; uses your last breath to escape death.
On a fatal blow: immune to this damage
Teleports back to your respawn point (or world spawn if no bed)
item.alone_adventure.parryshield.tooltip: Raise this shield at the moment an enemy strike lands for a perfect defense.
Block within 1s of raising: full immunity, reflects 250% damage and weakens the attacker for 3s (1s parry cooldown)
Held up longer: absorbs 80% of the damage
A mysterious weapon of an imperial far future, its blade driven by highly compressed energy, cleaving far beyond ordinary alloys.

Pierce: main attacks ignore armor toughness; against enemies with armor above 8, +0.3 damage per point over the threshold, and +0.5 per point of toughness above 6 (up to 10 total), this damage ignores armor and toughness

Overclock: activate with right-click (lasts 13s by default, costs 5 durability), grants Resistance II for 5s on activation, +50% attack damage while active, +3 fire damage and 4s ignition per hit, heals 60% of damage dealt; 30s cooldown (duration and cooldown configurable)
